notes: Synthetic prices and volumes generated by P.Book; neither live nor historical Optibook quotations, and unrelated to real-world namesake stocks.

Synthetic pricing uses shared primary stocks, bounded dual-listing basis, the course OB5X basket/divisor and ETF terms, cost-of-carry futures and zero-dividend European Black–Scholes options at declared volatility assumptions.

Synthetic marks are repriced each second, rounded to the contract tick and floored at one positive tick. Minute OHLC aggregates every knot including t0 and t1; small theoretical-value rounding differences are expected.
Synthetic volume is a deterministic count of virtual teaching units; it is not an observed tape or order-book liquidity.
Synthetic scene clock: 09:30–16:00 UTC on 2026-09-14, chosen by P.Book; it is not an Optibook trading-hours assertion. No market-data capture occurred.

Synthetic execution uses P.Book's own long-only, whole-unit, fully cash-funded teaching engine and simulated depth/fills. Derivative margin, exercise, delivery and exchange settlement are not implemented.
Synthetic price source is this generator. The source link identifies retained course contract metadata only; SIM denotes virtual P.Book account units.
